rules.name: ioc_golden_ioc_set_md5_1d04fb9b8d99bf85
rules.source:
import "hash"

rule ioc_golden_ioc_set_md5_1d04fb9b8d99bf85 : ioc md5
{
  meta:
    source = "breeze-ioc-import"
    label = "Golden \"IOC\" set"
    ioc_count = 1
  condition:
    with digest = hash.md5(0, filesize) : (
      digest == "44d88612fea8a8f36de82e1278abb02f"
    )
}
